services.desc: Cruise Duration Board: 5:30 pm Departs: 6:00 pm Returns: 7:30 pm Please arrive early for boarding. About Step aboard for a magical evening on the Lake of the Ozarks with a lightly narrated dinner cruise departing from the beautiful Margaritaville Lake Resort. Glide over the tranquil waters of the lake, basked in the soothing glow of the setting sun. Marvel at the breathtaking scenery that surrounds you. Relax and unwind as you savor a delectable dinner featuring a mouth-watering selection of dishes. services.name: Tropic Island Noon Narrated Cruise with Optional Lunch
services.desc: Enjoy the Lake of the Ozarks in Luxury! Duration 1 Hour and 30 Minutes cruise Total time including Boarding 2 hours About Join Tropic Island Cruise for our Noon Narrated Cruise with Optional Lunch. This cruise departs from our location at Margaritaville Resort in Osage Beach, Missouri. You and your guests will enjoy a relaxing cruise on the Lake Of The Ozarks. You may also opt to enjoy a light lunch as you cruise with friends. Lunch is optional. Lunch choices must be made at time of reservation, and prior to day of cruise. -$40.00 Adults - Cruise only -$20.00 Children ages 3-10 years - Cruise only -Children ages 2 years and younger are complimentary $53 Adults - Cruise and Lunch $33
